description: Use this first when the user's project needs icons or the user asks for icons, to learn their plan and how to present results. Not needed when the work adds no icons. Next: `search_families` to choose a Family, or `search_assets` if the project already uses a Set. Returns userContext (signed-in email and Streamline plan) and llmInstructions (how to present catalog results for this user). Call this before searching or recommending assets.
name: get_user_context
title: Get user profile
